notes: SBLGNT.LUK.21.8.v009 and v010 carry readings compatible with the ASV; no added or unrepresented token arises from the textual decisions.
μή takes the discontinuous that … not, μή being what carries the subordination of the warning clause; giving that to πλανηθῆτε under rule 85 remains defensible and is named in that unit's note.
ἤγγικεν → is at hand heads on hand, the copula and preposition belonging to the frame; rule 71 heads ἐγγύς → at hand the same way.
